text: PR #5428 update: fixed both remaining issues from the bot review's follow-on findings (commit b4e9621ff). (1) The post-read re-walk now uses containment.canonical_path instead of the raw *exact directory entry -- the original fix claimed to mirror read_physically_contained_file_snapshot()'s post-read check but was actually re-doing directory-entry resolution from scratch. (2) Added a dedicated regression test (test_launcher_artifact_admission_rejects_rename_during_read, new macro-gated set_launcher_artifact_post_read_test_hook()), verified it catches the regression by temporarily disabling the check. Deferred extracting a shared read-and-revalidate-path helper as issue #5434 (will benefit #5427 too) rather than expanding scope into the primitive mid-review. Exact-head Windows Native Validation redispatched (run 33465799753), launched a 3rd adversarial /code-review pass given rounds 1 and 2 both found real issues.
